// diagnostic

E0947

`_` stands for an arm's candidate only in the header of an `if` table

What

`_` stands for an arm's candidate only in the header of an `if` table

Why

In `if header { candidate -> body }` each candidate takes the place of the header's `_`; nowhere else does `_` have a value.

Fix

Write the value here, or move the test into an `if` header followed by `{` and its arms.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0947: Tests/UI/CBOREncodeDeprecated/stderr.
